title: Sakura Taisen 2: Kimi, Shinitamou Koto Nakare (Demo)
native_title: サクラ大戦２ ～君、死にたもうことなかれ～
overview:
Japan in the 1920s, in an alternate history powered by steam. Two years after leading the Imperial Floral Assault Troupe to victory, naval officer Ogami returns to the Imperial Theater, where the actresses of the Flower Division double as a secret force piloting steam-powered armor. With two new members joining the team, they face a new enemy: the mysterious secret society known as the Black Demon Society.

Sakura Taisen 2 combines two styles of play. In the adventure part, talk with the girls and build your relationships through the timed LIPS dialogue system, where hesitating can change the answers available - and their feelings affect how they perform in battle. In the battle part, command your upgraded units turn by turn on isometric battlefields and plan your strategy carefully, unleashing special attacks to turn the fight.

This disc is a demo version of the game.
